title: Agent Usage
summary: Claude and Codex limits, usage stats, and alerts.

commands.name: usage
commands.about: Agent usage: totals, limits, projects and collection

subcommands.name: summary
subcommands.about: Totals, day count and model spread for a window

args.name: days
args.help: How many recent days to include; omit for the full history

args.name: sources
args.help: Restrict to these collector ids, e.g. --source cli --source codex

subcommands.name: projects
subcommands.about: Spend per project, with its chats

args.name: chats
args.help: Show the chats inside each project

subcommands.name: limits
subcommands.about: Rate limits for Claude and Codex, as live gauges

subcommands.name: alerts
subcommands.about: What the alert notifier would do right now
subcommands.longAbout:
What the alert notifier would do right now.

A dry run: it reads the live windows and the stored notifier state, then reports which alerts a poll at this instant would post. Nothing is posted and no state is written, so it is safe to run repeatedly.

args.name: settings
args.help: Also print every switch, so a misfiring alert can be traced to one

subcommands.name: export
subcommands.about: Render usage as branded PNG cards, for sharing
subcommands.longAbout:
Render usage as branded PNG cards, for sharing.

A card never shows a repository name, a folder path, a chat title or a dollar cost: it exists to be posted somewhere public, and those are the four fields that would leak a client, an employer or an income.

args.name: cards
args.help: Which card. Repeat for several; `all` is every one. Defaults to all

args.name: output
args.help: A directory, or the destination file when there is exactly one card. Defaults to the current directory

args.name: days
args.help: How many recent days to include; omit for the full history

args.name: svg
args.help: Write the SVG rather than a PNG. Useful with no fonts installed, and for editing a card before posting it

subcommands.name: refresh
subcommands.about: Run the collector and rewrite usage.json

args.name: progress
args.help: Print each collector phase as it completes

commands.name: alerts
commands.about: Rate-limit alerts: the notifier's state, a delivery check and a reset

subcommands.name: state
subcommands.about: Print what the notifier is comparing against

subcommands.name: test
subcommands.about: Post one sample banner, to confirm notifications arrive at all
subcommands.longAbout:
Post one sample banner, to confirm notifications arrive at all.

Deliberately does not touch the notifier state: consuming a real edge to prove delivery works would suppress the alert being tested.

subcommands.name: clear
subcommands.about: Forget the remembered levels and zones
subcommands.longAbout:
Forget the remembered levels and zones.

Worth doing after changing a threshold, since the stored comparison is then against the old scale.
